The GitHub CLI commands `gh issue list` and `gh pr list` silently truncate results at their default limit of 30 without warning, so scripts must pass an explicit `--limit` and check for truncation.
Use this lesson when writing or debugging a script that counts issues or pull requests using the GitHub CLI.
The `gh issue list` command returns only the first 30 results by default and does not warn when it cuts the list short. This caused an audit script to report incorrect counts (e.g., 30 instead of 74).

lesson:
Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call, so a slow service cannot hold the caller's workers.
When writing code that calls another service over HTTP.
Set a timeout on every outbound HTTP call.
A call with no timeout can wait as long as the other service takes.
The Python requests library has no default timeout.
Passing timeout=(3, 10) bounds the wait to 3 seconds to connect and 10 seconds to read.
